{"id": "08190442-d269-4928-aaba-31d38c14fcf2", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "The command is below. I haven't run it. It targets 3 running instances and the alarm is currently in OK state.

**Targets (tag `ssm-skill-test=true`, all `t3.nano`, all running):**
- `i-1234567890abcdef0_3`
- `i-1234567890abcdef0_2`
- `i-1234567890abcdef0_4`

**Alarm:** `ssm-skill-test-cpu` (EC2 `CPUUtilization`), currently `OK`.

```bash
aws ssm start-automation-execution \
  --region us-east-1 \
  --document-name AWS-RestartEC2Instance \
  --target-parameter-name InstanceId \
  --targets "Key=tag:ssm-skill-test,Values=true" \
  --max-concurrency 1 \
  --max-errors 1 \
  --alarm-configuration '{"IgnorePollAlarmFailure":false,"Alarms":[{"Name":"ssm-skill-test-cpu"}]}' \
  --parameters "AutomationAssumeRole=[redacted ARN]<your-automation-role>"
```

**How it works**
- **Alarm stop:** `--alarm-configuration` attaches the alarm to the automation. If `ssm-skill-test-cpu` goes to `ALARM`, Systems Manager stops the automation and doesn't start restarts on the remaining instances.
- **Failed alarm checks:** `IgnorePollAlarmFailure: false` means that if Systems Manager can't check the alarm state, it also stops. This is the safer setting. Set it to `true` if you'd rather continue in that case.
- **One at a time:** `--max-concurrency 1` restarts instances one by one. The alarm is only checked between steps, so this gives it the most chances to stop the run before the next instance is touched. A restart already in progress when the alarm fires will finish. `--max-errors 1` also halts the run after the first failed restart.
- **Role:** `AutomationAssumeRole` is optional in this runbook. Replace the placeholder with your role, or drop the `--parameters` line to run under your own credentials. The role needs `ec2:StopInstances`, `ec2:StartInstances`, `ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus`, and `cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms`, and it needs to trust `ssm.amazonaws.com`.

**Before you run it**
- Restarting a `t3.nano` is brief downtime for that instance. If any of the three serve traffic, confirm that's fine.
- A restart that has already happened can't be undone by the alarm. The alarm only prevents further ones.
- The tag filter is evaluated at execution time. Any instance tagged `ssm-skill-test=true` by then will be included.

I can also run this for you. It would need your approval, and I'd need the automation role ARN, or I'd run it with the agent's own permissions.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
